content.about_subtitle: Our journey, mission, and commitment to excellence
content.about_story_one: Soul Reapers Esports (SRE) is a professional esports organization founded in 2023 with a focus on Rainbow Six Siege. Our mission is to develop talented players and compete at the highest level while maintaining a strong community presence.
content.about_story_two: With competitive rosters across multiple games, we provide a pathway for emerging talent to grow and succeed in esports.
content.about_mission: To create a player-first organization that fosters talent development, competitive excellence, and community engagement.
content.about_value_excellence: Striving for the highest standards in competition and performance
content.about_value_community: Building a supportive and engaged community around our teams
content.about_value_development: Nurturing talent and helping players reach their full potential
content.contact_subtitle: Connect with us and stay updated
content.contact_intro: Join our Discord community to stay updated with the latest news, matches, and events!
